title: Blue Iris Alert Weekly Clip Size Trend
dataSources: NVR object-detection (`frigate:event`), camera health (`camera:health`), alarm arm/disarm and life-safety (`alarm:event`), lock access (`lock:access`), plate recognition (`plate:detection`), doorbell (`doorbell:event`).
app: Frigate / Blue Iris NVR object-detection events, camera health, alarm and smart-lock logs, and licence-plate recognition via MQTT and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=blueiris:event clip_mb=*
| bin _time span=1w
| stats avg(clip_mb) as avg_duration, max(clip_mb) as worst_duration by _time
| sort _time
description: Trends the average and worst clip size for Blue Iris alert events each week.
value: Weekly timing trends show whether a process is becoming slower, more erratic, or healthier over time.
implementation: Capture clip_mb on each event and review weekly averages plus worst cases during your personal ops review.
visualization: Line chart of weekly average clip size with markers for the worst week.
grandmaExplanation: It predicts whether Blue Iris alert tasks are taking longer than they used to and where the slow weeks were.
